### Borea v0.4.0

Borea is the community content manager for Kitten Space Agency: find mods, install them with their dependencies into separate instances of the game, and launch through StarMap.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Coming from v0.3.x

Click "Update now" on the Home banner, or run `borea update-self`.
Your instances, mods and settings stay as they are.
Pins and mods detached from a modpack are new in the record of an instance. An older Borea still reads such an instance, but it drops the pins and the detached mods when it saves that instance. So once you pin or detach a mod, do not go back to v0.3.x with that instance.

#### Highlights

- Descriptions and release notes show all of their formatting: links open in the browser, and tables, lists, code and dividers look as the author wrote them.
- Select and copy text across a whole description, through paragraphs, headings, lists, tables and code.
- Pin a mod at its version, and Borea tells you when a pin holds back the update of another mod.
- Detach a mod from its modpack to choose its version yourself, and attach it again later.
- Mods that you installed by hand now show on the Content tab of the instance, below the mods that Borea manages.
- Filter Discover by more than one license.
- Mod authors see a preview of their description in the listing editor while they type.

#### For players

##### Descriptions and release notes

- Links in descriptions and release notes open in the browser and show their address when you point at them. A bare address such as `https://example.com` is a link too.
- Tables, dividers, nested lists, escaped characters, line breaks and `<br>` show as the author wrote them, with no Markdown characters left over.
- Inline code and code blocks take the colors of the theme instead of a black bar.
- A drag selects text across paragraphs, headings, list items, table cells and code blocks. Ctrl+C, or Copy in the right-click menu, copies the whole selection with a blank line between the blocks, and Ctrl+A selects the whole description. A press after the end of a line starts the selection there.
- Headings can be selected too.
- A link on the second or a later line of a long paragraph now opens on a click.

##### Instances

- The Content tab now also lists the mod folders that Borea did not install, in a table "Not managed by Borea" below the mods that Borea manages. The "Manual installs" tab is gone.
- Each of these rows says that Borea cannot update the mod. "Manage with Borea" is a button on the row, and "Replace with the latest release" is in its "..." menu.
- That table always has "Open folder" in its header, also when it is empty, so you can still add a mod by hand. Thanks to @LaurensDeV for the report.
- "Pin version" in the "..." menu of a mod keeps it at its installed version, and the row shows a pin mark. "Update all", the update of the mod itself and a pack update leave a pinned mod alone, and the other mods still move. "Unpin" takes the pin away.
- A plan that needs another version of a pinned mod stops and names the pin.
- When a pin keeps another mod from its newest release, the row of that mod says so, for example "2.0.0 needs Aircraft HUD >= 1.1.0, which is pinned at 1.0.0", instead of an update button. Home does not count it as an update.

##### Mod packs

- "Detach from modpack" in the "..." menu of a pack mod makes it a mod you chose, and it moves to the Mods group. A pack update leaves it at its version, and a detached mod that you remove does not come back with a later pack update.
- The instance header says how many mods differ from the pack, for example "2 mods differ from Tools Pack 1.0.0", and the pack update confirmation names each detached mod that it leaves alone.
- "Attach to modpack again" undoes it. When the mod is at another version than the pack pins, Borea asks before it changes to the pack's version.

##### Discover and mod pages

- The License filter shows each license once, such as MIT or CC-BY-SA-4.0, the most used first. You can select more than one, each selected license shows as a chip that removes it, and a mod or pack shows when its license names one of them. The Modpacks tab works the same way.
- The "..." menu of a mod or pack page has "Copy share link" and "Report". Report opens the takedown form or the id dispute form of the content index on GitHub, with the listing filled in, and says in one line what each form is for.

#### For mod authors

- The listing editor has a Preview switch next to the Description heading. The preview stands next to the description field, shows the description as the mod page shows it, with your images, and follows the text while you type.
- Borea now shows links, tables, dividers, nested lists, escapes, entities and hard line breaks in a description. Raw HTML shows only as its text. What the preview shows is what players see.

#### Command line

- `borea pin` and `borea unpin` pin a mod at its version and take the pin away.
- `borea pack detach` and `borea pack attach` detach a mod from the pack of its instance and attach it again.

#### Good to know

- This version is tested with KSA 2026.10.7.5541.
- Borea is a community project by the KSA Modding team. It is not made by RocketWerkz.
